options.name: action
options.description: The action the Firewall DNS policy rule takes when packets match the rule

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: application_groups
options.description: User-defined network service application group on which the rule is applied. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific network service application group.

options.name: applications
options.description: User-defined network service applications on which the rule is applied. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific network service application.

options.name: block_response_code
options.description: When the action is selected as BLOCK_WITH_RESPONSE to block the DNS traffic Send a response code to the client, specify the response code using this field.

options.name: capture_pcap
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: departments
options.description: The departments to which the Firewall DNS policy rule applies

options.name: description
options.description: Additional information about the rule

options.name: dest_addresses
options.description: List of destination IP addresses to which this rule will be applied. CIDR notation can be used for destination IP addresses.

options.name: dest_countries
options.description: Destination countries for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to specific destination countries. Provide a ISO3166 Alpha2 code.  visit the following site for reference U(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes)

options.name: dest_ip_categories
options.description: IP address categories of destination for which the DNAT rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to specific destination IP categories.

options.name: dest_ip_groups
options.description: User-defined destination IP address groups on which the rule is applied. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific destination IP address group.

options.name: dest_ipv6_groups
options.description: Destination IPv6 address groups for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IPv6 address group.

options.name: dns_gateway
options.description: The DNS gateway used to redirect traffic, specified when the rule action is to redirect DNS request to an external DNS service.

options.name: dns_rule_request_types
options.description: DNS request types to which the rule applies

options.name: enabled
options.description: Determines whether the Firewall DNS policy rule is enabled or disabled

options.name: groups
options.description: The groups to which the Firewall DNS policy rule applies

options.name: id
options.description: Unique identifier for the Firewall DNS policy rule

options.name: is_default_rule_name
options.description: If set to true, the default DNS rule name is used for the rule

options.name: is_web_eun_enabled
options.description: If set to true, Web EUN is enabled for the rule

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels that are applicable to the rule.

options.name: location_groups
options.description: The location groups to which the Firewall DNS policy rule applies

options.name: locations
options.description: The locations to which the Firewall DNS policy rule applies

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Firewall DNS policy rule

options.name: order
options.description: Rule order number of the Firewall DNS policy rule

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: protocols
options.description: List of protocols to which this rule applies

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: rank
options.description: Admin rank of the Firewall DNS policy rule

options.name: res_categories
options.description: List of destination domain categories to which the rule applies

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: source_countries
options.description: The list of source countries that must be included or excluded from the rule based on the excludeSrcCountries field value. If no value is set, this field is ignored during policy evaluation and the rule is applied to all source countries. Provide a ISO3166 Alpha2 code.  visit the following site for reference U(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes)

options.name: src_ip_groups
options.description: User-defined source IP address groups for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IP address group.

options.name: src_ips
options.description: User-defined source IP addresses for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IP address.

options.name: src_ipv6_groups
options.description: Source IPv6 address groups for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IPv6 address group.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: time_windows
options.description: The time interval in which the Firewall DNS policy rule applies

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: users
options.description: The users to which the Firewall DNS policy rule applies

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: zpa_ip_group
options.description: The ZPA IP pool used for domain name resolution when action is REDIR_ZPA.
